changes.description: `ContainerCredentialsResolver`, `HttpCredentialsClient` and `EcsContainerProvider` are now synchronous. The async implementations are now `AsyncContainerCredentialsResolver` and `AsyncEcsContainerProvider` in `aws_credentials_http.aio`, and `AsyncHttpCredentialsClient` in `aws_credentials_http.aio.client`. Update async code to the `Async` names.

`AsyncContainerCredentialsResolver` no longer leaks the `AIOHTTPClient` it creates by default; it opens and closes one for each credential fetch. An HTTP client passed to the resolver is still the caller's to close.
